title: Automatic Captions
description: Drop a video — transcribe it, then style, time and place the captions exactly how you want.
dropLabel: Drop a video here or click to browse
hint: Runs on your computer. The transcript is a fast starting point — edit anything that's wrong before generating.
editHint: Fix any words the transcription got wrong, adjust timing (in seconds), or remove a word.
fewWordsWarning: Very little speech was found — check the video has clear audio.
